messages:
ani_csm: Alert: ingestion backlog noticed 07:55 PDT affecting ~28 tenants; 6 are marked high-touch with renewals in next 30 days. Need comms + credit plan.

maria_cs: Thanks Ani. Can we confirm root cause quickly so messaging doesn't over-explain?

sre_oncall: Quick update: intermittent object-store 5xx errors triggered aggressive retries in our batch worker; worker pool became saturated. We applied a temporary rate cap at 08:40 and ingestion rate recovered by 09:10. Full fix (retry jitter + idempotency) ETA ~18h.

leo_support: Created tickets CS-8300..CS-8327 and queued manual re-run tasks. Will only re-run on explicit customer request with upload_id to avoid duplication.

tara_eng: Well add note to outbound: include upload ID + approx upload timestamp. Eng will publish RCA draft within 48h.

ani_csm: Drafting two versions of outbound copy now: short high-touch and short trial. Pasting: 

ani_csm: "Hi <Name>, we observed delays with your data upload earlier today. We've applied a mitigation and can prioritize a re-run at no cost to prevent any renewal impact. Reply with the upload ID or pick a re-run slot and we'll handle it. We'll share a short RCA within 48 hours.
Thanks, <CSM>"

ani_csm: Trial automation: "Hi — you may have experienced a short delay in data ingestion this morning. The issue is mitigated. Reply if you want a re-run; trials will receive a 1-month credit. We'll follow up with an RCA."

maria_cs: Good. Add explicit "we will prioritize activation to avoid renewal impact" line for high-touch. Also include link to a 1-question survey after re-run.

alan_support_bot: Support tickets linked and tag "onboard-backlog-2026-03" added. Calendar slots created for priority re-runs.

leo_support: Reminder to AEs: don't schedule re-runs without upload ID. We added a dedupe flag to the support runbook.

sre_oncall: Logging timeline in incident tracker. Will announce when patch merges to canary.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) Ani send high-touch emails now, 2) Maria queue automated trial notifications, 3) Support runs re-runs only with upload ID, 4) Eng posts RCA within 48h, 5) Trials get 1-month credit, high-touch prioritized activation.

ani_csm: Sending high-touch now and tagging AEs. I'll surface any replies here.

leo_support: Support team standing by for re-runs. Thanks everyone.
